contract: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"1 <= t <= 10**5","description":"The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100,000."},{"id":"P2","expression":"2 <= n <= 10**6","description":"The length of the string s for each test case must be between 2 and 1,000,000."},{"id":"P3","expression":"all(c in 'abc' for c in s)","description":"The string s must consist only of the characters 'a', 'b', and 'c'."},{"id":"P4","expression":"sum(n for n in lengths) <= 10**6","description":"The total length of all strings s across all test cases must not exceed 1,000,000."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"stdout == str(min_length) if min_length != -1 else '-1'","description":"The output must be the length of the smallest valid substring or -1 if no such substring exists."},{"id":"Q2","expression":"min_length >= 2","description":"The length of the smallest valid substring must be at least 2."},{"id":"Q3","expression":"all(s[i:j].count('a') > s[i:j].count('b') and s[i:j].count('a') > s[i:j].count('c') for i in range(n) for j in range(i+2, n+1) if s[i:j].count('a') > s[i:j].count('b') and s[i:j].count('a') > s[i:j].count('c'))","description":"The output must correspond to a valid substring where 'a' occurs strictly more times than '
